mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The decline is measured as the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.5 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has fallen below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS have increased by at least 1% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% year-over-year), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary easing that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 102.5 (index 2017=100) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, which boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 102.5.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals a tightening labor market that increases consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE falls below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) and a stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates persistent inflationary pressures, which typically lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed may delay rate cuts.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% and FEDFUNDS is at or below 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a rapidly strengthening labor market, which accelerates consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases by at least 0.1 percentage points and PAYEMS increases by at least 500 thousand persons over the prior month.
